parent_evidence.motivation: 1H MAE-only conditioning improved drawdown and lower-tail outcomes but slightly reduced average/median return, so test a distinct opportunity-per-unit-risk consumer rather than retuning MAE-only weights

source.timestamp_contract: America/New_York right-close labels -> DST-aware UTC -> subtract one minute -> UTC bar start

opportunity_policy.signal_gate: prior-only chronological inner-OOF q50 absolute predicted normalized move

risk_model.model: timestamp-corrected fixed H4 q80 HistGradientBoosting MAE estimator
risk_model.availability: latest fully completed-hour score only; OOS missing score fails closed

consumer.name: opportunity_to_mae_exposure_neutral_budget
consumer.training_reference: prior Ridge-selected rows with chronology-valid completed-hour risk score only
consumer.side_specific_opportunity_reference: median absolute Ridge predicted move-z among prior selected signals of the same side
consumer.side_specific_risk_reference: median predicted MAE-z among prior selected signals of the same side
consumer.opportunity_intensity: abs(current Ridge predicted move-z) / prior same-side median abs Ridge predicted move-z
consumer.risk_intensity: current side-specific predicted MAE-z / prior same-side median predicted MAE-z
consumer.training_normalization: divide by mean first-clipped raw quality across prior selected training signals only
consumer.cost_scaling: point costs scale proportionally with fractional research exposure

advancement.passing_meaning: advance unchanged to a separately frozen corrected-2026 confirmation only

nq_boundary: NQ remains excluded until this exact MNQ consumer passes discovery and an unchanged corrected-2026 confirmation
authority_boundary: research evidence only; no StrategySpec, runtime, broker, capital, sizing or live-trading authority
